verdict.rationale: Bitbucket documents several event-triggered automations — Jira issue status updates from commit messages (docs-1/18), AI-powered pipeline workflows triggered on pipeline events (docs-4), and customizable merge checks enforcing policies automatically (docs-6/7) — which together show rule-like, event-driven automation. However, there is no documentation of a general-purpose, user-definable rules engine (e.g., custom webhook-triggered actions or a rule editor) beyond these built-in behaviors. Missing for 10: a documented custom rule/automation builder, evidence of arbitrary event-to-action mapping, and independent corroboration of these automations working in practice.
